decision: Tightened Ep 7 script to 13 lines (~70 words, ~29 s cartoon + 4-5 s real + cards ~37 s)
why: Series brief asks for 30-40 s; draft had no question beat, no running gag and no phone hand-off

decision: Each material line leads with where it goes (inside/outside/brackets/bends)
why: Four places are easier for a viewer to remember than five material names; keeps claims qualitative

decision: Dropped PETG 'dull look over time' visual; merged nylon + CF into one 'carbon-fiber nylon' line
why: The dulling implies an unsourced claim; merging saves ~1.5 s; owner confirms the exact blend

decision: Phone hand-off varied: Pip 'Like these?!' / Gus '...Yeah. Like those.'
why: Series rule: vary the hand-off line per episode (pilot used '...Show me.')

decision: Ending changed to the logo card only; teaser card dropped unless a matching full video exists
why: Owner note relayed 2026-11-16: videos do not need to link to a YouTube video (lessons.md + SESSION_BRIEF.md on base branch)
